purpose: Prevent future runtimes from understating, diluting, conflating or overclaiming established AMX evidence.
rules: Earlier proven capability remains weighted evidence unless later evidence directly falsifies the same claim.
A harder later milestone cannot be retroactively treated as though it was part of an earlier acceptance contract.
Missing comparison population means UNRANKED / COMPARATIVE BENCHMARK NOT ESTABLISHED; it is not negative evidence.
A missing sub-artifact cannot downgrade an independently proven broader claim.
No source may be promoted beyond its bounded scope.
Provider, canonical ledger, projection, scheduler and report layers are distinct evidence classes.
Assumption/HYPOTHESIS/UNKNOWN may not mutate operational truth.
